text:
Hello,

I’m Mina Castellan, a data and reporting freelancer with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard design, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’d be glad to help you build a practical project tracking template in PowerPoint and Excel for real-estate development reporting.

For this kind of management update, I focus on making the template clear, easy to maintain, and useful for top-level decision-making. I can structure it to track milestones and timeline progress, budgeted vs actual cost, and overall project status in a way that is easy for your team to update and easy for leadership to review. Since you want a template used across projects, I would aim for a consistent format that helps compare projects side by side and quickly spot delays, overruns, and priority items.

A relevant project I completed was an HR attrition dashboard for a manufacturing client. I built an attrition and absence dashboard using Power BI, Excel, and SQL, and included row-level security so each plant manager could only see their own plant. The dashboard covered 1,900 employees and helped surface attrition hotspots in 2 plants. That project required careful structuring of data, clear presentation for managers, and a strong focus on usability and visibility for different stakeholders.

For your project, I can create a template that is professional, management-friendly, and flexible enough to support ongoing updates. In Excel, I can set up the tracking logic and clean input structure. In PowerPoint, I can design the reporting layout so project status can be presented clearly to top management. I’m comfortable working with dashboard-style reporting and turning complex project data into simple summaries that support action.

If you’d like, I can also help think through the fields and layout so the template is well suited to real-estate project tracking from the start. I’d be happy to discuss your preferred structure and reporting format.
